cards.name: Lena, Selfless Champion
lines: Sacrifice ~: Creatures you control with power less than ~'s power gain indestructible until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Creatures you control with power less than Lena's power' needs a strict source-relative power comparison, but the schema's source-relative power selector (powerAtMostSource) is 'equal or lesser' and event-only.

cards.name: Savor the Moment
lines: Take an extra turn after this one. Skip the untap step of that turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second sentence, 'Skip the untap step of that turn' (the extra turn's untap step), has no op or flag in the schema.

cards.name: Siege Behemoth
lines: As long as this creature is attacking, for each creature you control, you may have that creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets a creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked, so the 'as long as this creature is attacking, for each creature you control, you may have that creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked' line cannot be stated.

cards.name: Sigil of Valor
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each other creature you control.
validatorIssues: answer is not valid JSON in the required shape: SyntaxError: JSON Parse error: Expected ']'
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature has "Whenever this creature attacks alone, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of other creatures you control."

cards.name: Molten Slagheap
lines: {1}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost removes X storage counters where X is an announced value, and the schema has no announced-X cost for removing counters, so the mana produced cannot be tied to the number actually removed.

cards.name: Geyser Drake
lines: During turns other than yours, spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
cards.backTranslation: As long as it is not your turn, spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

cards.name: Arterial Flow
lines: Each opponent discards two cards. If you control a Vampire, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
cards.backTranslation:
Each opponent discards two cards.
Then if you control a Vampire, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Guildpact Informant
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, proliferate.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's combat-damage trigger (dealsCombatDamageToPlayer) covers only players, with no variant for combat damage dealt to a planeswalker.

cards.name: Jhoira's Timebug
lines: {T}: Choose target permanent you control or suspended card you own. If that permanent or card has a time counter on it, you may remove a time counter from it or put another time counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target 'suspended card you own' is a card in exile, and the schema's target kinds cover permanents and graveyard cards but not exiled cards.

cards.name: Sigiled Sword of Valeron
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance that's attacking.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance that is attacking.

cards.name: Stick Together
lines: Each player chooses a party from among creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player choosing a party of Cleric, Rogue, Warrior and Wizard creatures and sacrificing the rest has no op; choosePermanentTypesThenSacrificeOthers works by card type, not by creature subtype.

cards.name: Ancient Stirrings
lines: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a colorless card from among them and put it into your hand. Then put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches colorless cards, so 'reveal a colorless card' cannot be written as the lookAtTopN filter.

cards.name: Radical Idea
lines: Jump-start
cards.backTranslation: You may cast this spell from a graveyard by discarding a card and paying {1}{U} rather than paying its mana cost. If this spell was cast this way, exile it as it resolves instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
differences: Text A's jump-start is an additional cost: cast from the graveyard by paying its other costs (its mana cost) plus discarding a card. Text B makes the spell's cost a replacement of the mana cost, stated as a fixed {1}{U} rather than paying its mana cost, and Text A states no such fixed amount.
Text B's exile applies when the spell is cast this way and resolves; Text A exiles the card after it is cast with jump-start, with no resolution condition stated.

cards.name: Frontline Heroism
lines: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste, then copy that spell. The copy targets that token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The copy must target the token created just before it; copy ops only allow optional new targets, and a castsSpell filter cannot say 'targets only a single creature you control'.

cards.name: Master of the Wild Hunt
lines: {T}: Tap all untapped Wolf creatures you control. Each Wolf tapped this way deals damage equal to its power to target creature. That creature deals damage equal to its power divided as its controller chooses among any number of those Wolves.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot express the tapped Wolves each dealing damage to the target creature while that creature's controller divides its damage back among those same Wolves, since dealDamageDivided only divides damage among targets chosen by the controller of the ability.

cards.name: Eshki, Temur's Roar
lines: Whenever you cast a creature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on ~. If that spell's power is 4 or greater, draw a card. If that spell's power is 6 or greater, ~ deals damage equal to ~'s power to each opponent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The damage clause 'if that spell's power is 6 or greater, Eshki deals damage equal to its power' needs the cast spell's power as a condition, which no schema value or condition reads, and splitting it into separate triggers would not fix the order in which the counter and the damage happen.

cards.name: The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
lines: All creatures have "At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy this creature unless you pay {1}."
cards.backTranslation: Each creature has "At the beginning of your upkeep, unless its controller pays {1}, destroy this creature."

cards.name: Mr. Orfeo, the Boulder
lines: Whenever you attack, double target creature's power until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack, double the power of target creature.
differences: Text A's power doubling lasts until end of turn; Text B has no duration, so its doubling is permanent.

cards.name: Tainted Sigil
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain life equal to the total life lost by all players this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no value for the total life lost by all players this turn (opponentsLostLifeThisTurn covers only opponents), so the gain amount cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Arena Rector
lines: When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, search your library for a planeswalker card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot make the planeswalker search depend on 'if you do' after an optional exile of the dying card, since exileGraveyardEventCard and the search have no linked dependency.

cards.name: Poxwalkers
lines: Curse of the Walking Pox — Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The return-to-battlefield-tapped ops are tied to a dying or departed source (persist, undying, Malakir Rebirth), not to a graveyard-functioning cast trigger that returns its own card tapped, so 'return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Empyrial Plate
lines: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each card in your hand.
validatorIssues: answer is not valid JSON in the required shape: SyntaxError: JSON Parse error: Expected ']'
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature gets +X/+X, where X is the number of cards in your hand.

cards.name: District Guide
lines: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card or Gate card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a card that is both a basic land card and a land card, or a land card with the subtype Gate, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Alpha Status
lines: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 for each other creature on the battlefield that shares a creature type with it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector or value counts other creatures that share a creature type with the enchanted creature, so the +2/+2 per matching creature cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Activated Sleeper
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn, except it's a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The entersAsCopy choice only ranges over permanents on the battlefield, and the schema cannot select a creature card in a graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn.

cards.name: Malboro
lines: Bad Breath — When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card, loses 2 life, and exiles the top three cards of their library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles the top three cards of each opponent's library: exileLibraryTop takes one card and its 'each' form also hits the controller's own library.

cards.name: Silverfur Partisan
lines: Whenever a Wolf or Werewolf you control becomes the target of an instant or sorcery spell, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The becomesTargeted trigger has no filter for the targeting object being an instant or sorcery spell, so it would also fire when the creature is targeted by an ability.

cards.name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent was put into your hand from the battlefield this turn, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition checks whether a permanent was put into your hand from the battlefield this turn.

cards.name: Gatewatch Beacon
lines: Whenever a planeswalker you control enters, if this artifact has loyalty counters on it, you may move a loyalty counter from this artifact onto that planeswalker.
cards.backTranslation: When a planeswalker you control enters, if this has one or more loyalty counters on it, you may move one loyalty counter from this onto that planeswalker.

cards.name: Bower Passage
lines: Creatures with flying can't block creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The rule stops flying creatures blocking creatures you control, but the only blocking restriction shapes are cantBlockMatching (by blocker only) and cantBlockCreatures (by attacker filter with a power comparison), so no static pairs a blocker filter with an attacker filter.

cards.name: Breeches, the Blastmaker
lines: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, flip a coin. When you win the flip, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. When you lose the flip, ~ deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The win and lose branches of the coin flip are reflexive triggers that choose their own targets after the flip, but the schema's flipCoin branches cannot hold a target, and a trigger-level 'any target' would be chosen before the flip and could fizzle the copy.

cards.name: Beorn's Hospitality
lines: {5}{G}{G}: ~ becomes a Bear creature in addition to its other types and gains "~'s power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes this enchantment a permanent Bear creature with a granted static power/toughness ability when an activated ability resolves: becomeCreatureUntilEot lasts only until end of turn and sourceGainsAbility can grant only a mana or activated ability, not a static P/T setting.

cards.name: Chaos Mutation
lines: Exile any number of target creatures controlled by different players. For each creature exiled this way, its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card, puts that card onto the battlefield, then puts the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no op that makes each exiled creature's controller reveal cards until a creature card and put it onto the battlefield, and no target slot that requires the chosen creatures to have different controllers.

cards.name: Model of Unity
lines: Whenever players finish voting, you and each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for may scry 2.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for players finishing a vote, so "whenever players finish voting" cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Bonder's Ornament
lines: {4}, {T}: Each player who controls a permanent named ~ draws a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot make each player who controls a permanent named Bonder's Ornament draw a card; eachPlayerDraws draws for every player regardless of control, and there is no per-player named-permanent condition.

cards.name: Xyris, the Writhing Storm
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, you and that player each draw that many cards.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you draw a number of cards equal to the damage dealt. That player draws a number of cards equal to the damage dealt.

cards.name: Forsworn Paladin
lines: {2}{B}: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. If mana from a Treasure was spent to activate this ability, that creature also gains deathtouch until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The deathtouch grant conditioned on Treasure mana having been spent to activate the ability has no schema condition at resolution, and the +2/+0 half alone would be an approximation.

cards.name: Melded Moxite
lines: When this artifact enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
cards.backTranslation: When this artifact enters, you may discard two cards. If you do, draw two cards.
differences: Text A has the controller discard one card ("discard a card") and, if they do, draw two cards; Text B has the controller discard two cards ("discard two cards") before drawing two cards.

cards.name: Cunning Maneuver
lines: Create a Clue token.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn.
Create a Clue, a colorless artifact token with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card."

cards.name: Gnarlwood Dryad
lines: ~ gets +2/+2 as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +2/+2.

cards.name: Karametra's Blessing
lines: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's an enchanted creature or enchantment creature, it also gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
If that creature is enchanted, or is an enchantment creature, it gains hexproof until end of turn and indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Audacious Reshapers
lines: {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal an artifact card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. ~ deals damage to you equal to the number of cards revealed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op reveals cards from the top of a library until an artifact card is revealed and puts that card onto the battlefield with the rest on the bottom.

cards.name: Fateful Showdown
lines: ~ deals damage to any target equal to the number of cards in your hand. Discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The draw count must equal the number of cards discarded (the hand size before discarding), and no op reads that count before the discard, so 'discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Moorland Haunt
lines: {W}{U}, {T}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost exiles a creature card from the graveyard, and the only graveyard exile cost (exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard) cannot restrict the exiled cards to creatures.

cards.name: Compy Swarm
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, create a tapped token that's a copy of this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf cannot make the copy enter tapped, and createToken cannot copy this creature, so 'create a tapped token that's a copy of this creature' has no exact op.

cards.name: The Cyber-Controller
lines: When ~ enters, each opponent mills X cards. Put all creature cards milled this way onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect puts the creature cards milled this way onto the battlefield face down as 2/2 artifact creatures under your control (only return-to-hand or return-by-selection milled-card ops exist).

cards.name: Marit Lage's Slumber
lines: Whenever ~ or another snow permanent you control enters, scry 1.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this enchantment or another Snow permanent you control enters, scry 1.

cards.name: Moggcatcher
lines: {3}, {T}: Search your library for a Goblin permanent card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: {3}, {T}: Search a library for a Goblin card that isn't an instant or sorcery card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches your library; Text B searches a library (any library), so it could find a Goblin in an opponent's library.

cards.name: Oath of Jace
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, scry X, where X is the number of planeswalkers you control.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, scry X, where X is the number of planeswalkers you control.

cards.name: Averna, the Chaos Bloom
lines: As you cascade, you may put a land card from among the exiled cards onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The option to put a land card from among the cascaded exiled cards onto the battlefield tapped has no schema form.

cards.name: Master Piandao
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Ally, Equipment, or Lesson card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Ally, Equipment, or Lesson card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Tiamat's Fanatics
lines: Myriad
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad's token copies for each opponent other than the defending player, each an optional choice, exiled at end of combat, have no schema form: createTokenForEachOpponent does not exclude the defender and createTokenCopyOf exiles only at the end step.

cards.name: Carrier Thrall
lines: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {C}."

cards.name: Clockwork Percussionist
lines: When this creature dies, exile the top card of your library. You may play it until the end of your next turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's play-from-exile permissions last only until end of turn (exileTopNPlayableUntilEot), and nothing expresses "until the end of your next turn".

cards.name: Scrounging Bandar
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto another target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Moving any number of counters chosen by the player onto a target creature cannot be expressed, since moveCounters takes a fixed count and distributeCountersFromSource has no target.

cards.name: Journey to Nowhere
lines: When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that returns the card this enchantment exiled to the battlefield under its owner's control when the enchantment leaves; returnExiledAttachedCard returns to hand, and the exile itself is not linked to this permanent.

cards.name: Dauthi Embrace
lines: {B}{B}: Target creature gains shadow until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Shadow is not a keyword the schema can grant, since grantKeywordUntilEot accepts only the implemented keyword list.

cards.name: Fraying Omnipotence
lines: Each player loses half their life, then discards half the cards in their hand, then sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice. Round up each time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value is half of life, hand, or creatures rounded up, and loseLife, discard, and sacrifice take only fixed amounts or single-target counts.

cards.name: Coercive Portal
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, starting with you, each player votes for carnage or homage. If carnage gets more votes, sacrifice this artifact and destroy all nonland permanents. If homage gets more votes or the vote is tied, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, council's vote: each player votes for carnage or homage. If carnage gets more votes, sacrifice this artifact and destroy each nonland permanent on the battlefield. Otherwise, draw a card.
differences: Text A says each player votes 'starting with you'; Text B omits the starting player of the vote, so the voting order is not stated.

cards.name: God-Pharaoh's Gift
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie. It gains haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token copy must be a 4/4 black Zombie, but createTokenCopyOf has no color override, and the optionally exiled graveyard card cannot be bound as the copy source.

cards.name: Ms. Bumbleflower
lines: Whenever you cast a spell, target opponent draws a card. Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying until end of turn. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, you draw two cards.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever you cast a spell, target opponent draws a card, and target creature gets a +1/+1 counter and gains flying until end of turn.
If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, you draw two cards.

cards.name: Fear, Fire, Foes!
lines: Damage can't be prevented this turn. ~ deals X damage to target creature and 1 damage to each other creature with the same controller.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no 'damage can't be prevented this turn' effect, so the first sentence cannot be stated.

cards.name: Spellbook Vendor
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {1}. When you do, create a Sorcerer Role token attached to target creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot state the Role token's uniqueness rule (if you control another Role on the creature, put that one into the graveyard), so the attached Sorcerer Role token cannot be created exactly.

cards.name: Sword of Kaldra
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals damage to a creature, exile that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger fires when the equipped creature deals damage to a creature; dealtDamage watches the object that is damaged, not the source that deals the damage.

cards.name: Emissary Green
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, starting with you, each player votes for profit or security. You create a number of Treasure tokens equal to twice the number of profit votes. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control equal to the number of security votes.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no profit-or-security vote that scales Treasure tokens by profit votes and +1/+1 counters on each creature by security votes (the only vote op exiles the most-voted permanent).

cards.name: Furious Rise
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until you exile another card with this enchantment.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The exiled card stays playable until a later exile by this enchantment, but exileTopNPlayableUntilEot only lasts until end of turn, so that duration cannot be stated.

cards.name: Dungeon Map
lines: {3}, {T}: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect for venturing into the dungeon (entering a dungeon room or advancing to the next room).

cards.name: Shadow of the Grave
lines: Return to your hand all cards in your graveyard that you cycled or discarded this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector or zone effect can pick out only the cards this turn that were cycled or discarded, because the schema tracks no per-turn record of cycling or discarding for graveyard cards.

cards.name: Elemental Mastery
lines: Enchanted creature has "{T}: Create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste, where X is this creature's power. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted tap ability creates tokens that are exiled at the beginning of the next end step, and no op exiles tokens created by an ability at that time.

cards.name: Drake Haven
lines: Whenever you cycle or discard a card, you may pay {1}. If you do, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema does not say whether the discardsCard trigger fires for a cycling cost (discardSelf), so 'whenever you cycle or discard a card' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Hero of Precinct One
lines: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell that is two or more colors, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.

cards.name: Traitorous Greed
lines: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Add two mana of any one color.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mana half, 'Add two mana of any one color', needs both produced units locked to one chosen color, and addMana only offers one color decision per mana, so two different colors could be chosen.

cards.name: Mists of Lórien
lines: Return target nonland permanent and each other nonland permanent with the same mana value as that permanent to their owners' hands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A selector cannot match 'each other nonland permanent with the same mana value as the target', since the mana value filters take only fixed numbers and cannot reference the target.

cards.name: Embrace the Paradox
lines: Draw three cards. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: handToBattlefield cannot put the land onto the battlefield tapped; it has no tapped option.

cards.name: Harsh Mercy
lines: Each player chooses a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of a type chosen this way. They can't be regenerated.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player choosing a creature type as the spell resolves, then destroying creatures not of a chosen type, has no schema op or selector for per-player resolution-time type choice.

cards.name: Shifting Ceratops
lines: {G}: ~ gains your choice of reach, trample, or haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: {G}: Choose one — This creature gains reach until end of turn; or this creature gains trample until end of turn; or this creature gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Errant and Giada
lines: You may cast spells with flash or flying from the top of your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The top-of-library cast permission filtered to spells with flash or flying needs a keyword selector, and hasKeyword is event-only so it cannot filter a castFromZone permission.

cards.name: Gremlin Tamer
lines: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, create a 1/1 red Gremlin creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for 'whenever you fully unlock a Room', so the second half of the Eerie line cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Tithe
lines: Search your library for a Plains card. If target opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for an additional Plains card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The extra search depends on whether the chosen target opponent controls more lands than you, but opponentControlsMore compares every opponent rather than the targeted one.

cards.name: Fae Offering
lines: At the beginning of each end step, if you've cast both a creature spell and a noncreature spell this turn, create a Clue token, a Food token, and a Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The end-step condition requires having cast both a creature spell and a noncreature spell this turn, and castSpellThisTurn can count only any spell or noncreature spells, with no creature category.

cards.name: Iron Monger, Sadistic Tycoon
lines: Whenever a creature you control connives, put a +1/+1 counter on each Villain you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger event for a creature you control conniving (the connive effect exists, but no trigger listens for it).

cards.name: Dragonspark Reactor
lines: {4}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to target player and that much damage to up to one target creature.
cards.backTranslation: {4}, Sacrifice this artifact: Choose target player and up to one target creature. This deals damage to that player equal to the number of charge counters on this artifact. This deals damage equal to the number of charge counters on this artifact to each chosen creature.

cards.name: Markov Purifier
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, you may pay {2}. If you do, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if 'if you gained life this turn' has no condition form, since no life-gained-this-turn condition exists.

cards.name: Public Thoroughfare
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you tap an untapped artifact or land you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The sacrifice-unless payment is tapping an untapped artifact or land you control, but unlessPays accepts only a mana cost.

cards.name: Emissary Escort
lines: ~ gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest mana value among other artifacts you control.
validatorIssues: Invalid ability IR at definition.staticEffects[0].op.power: static value the layer engine cannot evaluate
cards.inexpressibleReason: The layer engine cannot evaluate greatestManaValueAmong in a static power value, and no other IR value says the greatest mana value among other artifacts you control.

cards.name: Teyo, the Shieldmage
lines: You have hexproof.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no static that gives the controller (a player, not a permanent) hexproof; controllerHexproofUntilEot is an until-end-of-turn effect only.

cards.name: Aven Courier
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, choose a counter on a permanent you control. Put a counter of that kind on target permanent you control if it doesn't have a counter of that kind on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to choose a counter kind from among those on permanents you control and then place that kind on a target permanent.

cards.name: Gigantoplasm
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "{X}: ~ has base power and toughness X/X."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted '{X}: this creature has base power and toughness X/X' ability needs a permanent base power and toughness set from X, and the schema's P/T-setting effect (becomeCreatureUntilEot) lasts only until end of turn.

cards.name: Soul Diviner
lines: {T}, Remove a counter from an artifact, creature, land, or planeswalker you control: Draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost 'remove a counter' of any kind from an artifact, creature, land, or planeswalker you control has no form: removeCountersFromAmong requires one named counter kind.

cards.name: Amy Rose
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, attach up to one target Equipment to her. Then up to one other target attacking creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is ~'s power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Attach up to one target Equipment to her' has no op: attachSelfTo attaches only the ability's own source, and no op attaches a targeted Equipment to another permanent.

cards.name: Skycoach Waypoint
lines: {3}, {T}: Target creature becomes prepared.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The becomePrepared effect takes no target, so "Target creature becomes prepared" cannot name the chosen creature.

cards.name: Decode Transmissions
lines: Void — If a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, instead you draw two cards and each opponent loses 2 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Void condition (a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn, or a spell was warped this turn) has no matching condition in the schema.

cards.name: Goblin Dark-Dwellers
lines: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op casts a targeted graveyard instant or sorcery for free with a replacement that exiles it instead of putting it into the graveyard; castOneFromHandFreeUpTo reads only the hand.

cards.name: Ranger of Eos
lines: When this creature enters, you may search your library for up to two creature cards with mana value 1 or less, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, you may search your library for two creature cards with mana value 1 or less, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches for up to two creature cards; Text B says two, so it removes the option to find fewer than two.

cards.name: Spider-Man Noir
lines: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then surveil X, where X is the number of counters on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The surveil op takes a fixed number, not a value read from the counters on the creature, so 'surveil X, where X is the number of counters on it' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Tainted Indulgence
lines: Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The condition 'five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard' counts distinct mana values, which no condition or value in the schema can express.

cards.name: Market Gnome
lines: When this creature is exiled from the battlefield while you're activating a craft ability, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger condition checks that the battlefield exile happened while its controller was activating a craft ability, and leavesBattlefield with leavesTo exile would also fire on every other exile.

cards.name: Iron Man, Bleeding Edge
lines: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you may copy it, except the copy isn't legendary. Do this only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: copyCastSpell makes a copy of the spell with no way to say 'the copy isn't legendary' and the copy becomes a token, which the copy op cannot express for an artifact spell.

cards.name: Colossal Plow
lines: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, add {W}{W}{W} and you gain 3 life. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, add {W}{W}{W}. This mana is persistent. You gain 3 life.

cards.name: Fire Sages
lines: Firebending 1
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mana from Firebending lasts until end of combat, but the mana persistence flag only keeps mana until end of turn, which would be a wrong card.

cards.name: Angel of the Dire Hour
lines: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, exile all attacking creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if 'if you cast it from your hand' has no from-hand condition (sourceWasCast accepts a cast from any zone), so the exile cannot be gated exactly.

cards.name: From the Rubble
lines: At the beginning of your end step, return target creature card of the chosen type from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to give a creature returned from the graveyard a finality counter, nor a replacement that exiles a creature with a finality counter instead of letting it die.

cards.name: Círdan the Shipwright
lines: Whenever ~ enters or attacks, each player secretly votes for a player, then those votes are revealed. Each player draws a card for each vote they received. Each player who received no votes may put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has only a public vote (voteAndExileMost, for choosing a permanent), with no secret simultaneous vote for a player that is then revealed and drawn from or used to put permanents onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Last Night Together
lines: Choose two target creatures. Untap them. Put two +1/+1 counters on each of them. They gain vigilance, indestructible, and haste until end of turn. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase. Only the chosen creatures can attack during that combat phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op untaps the chosen two-creature target slot, and no restriction limits the additional combat phase to attacks by the chosen creatures.

cards.name: Misthollow Griffin
lines: You may cast this card from exile.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'You may cast this card from exile' at its normal cost has no permission: castFromZone supports only the library top, and alternativeCasts models a different cost rather than a zone permission.

cards.name: Ministrant of Obligation
lines: Afterlife 2
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, create two 1/1 white and black Spirit creature tokens with flying.

cards.name: Practiced Offense
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls. Target creature gains your choice of double strike or lifelink until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Target player and target creature.
Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature that target player controls.
Choose one —
• Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
• Target creature gains lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Creepy Doll
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, flip a coin. If you win the flip, destroy that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for this creature dealing combat damage to a creature (dealsCombatDamageToPlayer is the only combat-damage trigger), so the coin flip and destroy of 'that creature' cannot be attached to the right event.

cards.name: Synthetic Destiny
lines: Exile all creatures you control. At the beginning of the next end step, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards, put all creature cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed end-step effect (reveal until that many creature cards, put them onto the battlefield, shuffle the rest into the library) has no schema op.

cards.name: Moonlight Hunt
lines: Choose target creature you don't control. Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf deals damage equal to its power to that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: damageEach takes one source for every damage event, so "each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf deals damage equal to its power to that creature" (each source dealing its own power) has no schema form.

cards.name: Invoke Despair
lines: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. If they can't, they lose 2 life and you draw a card. Then repeat this process for an enchantment and a planeswalker.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no op for a targeted opponent to sacrifice a creature, enchantment or planeswalker of their choice with an 'if they can't' fallback of losing 2 life and the controller drawing, repeated for each type.

cards.name: Curse of Shaken Faith
lines: Whenever enchanted player casts a spell other than the first spell they cast each turn or copies a spell, this Aura deals 2 damage to them.
cards.inexpressibleReason: castsSpell's caster can only be you, opponent or each, with no 'enchanted player' option, and it has no 'other than the first spell this turn' qualifier tied to the enchanted player.

cards.name: Synth Infiltrator
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's a Synth artifact creature in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The entersAsCopy addition can add the Artifact card type but has no field for adding the Synth creature subtype, so 'a Synth artifact creature in addition to its other types' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Chakra Meditation
lines: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card. Then discard a card unless there are three or more Lesson cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card. Then if there are three or more cards with the subtype Lesson in your graveyard, nothing happens. Otherwise, discard a card.

cards.name: Dungeon Descent
lines: {4}, {T}, Tap an untapped legendary creature you control: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Venture effect, so "Venture into the dungeon" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Strago and Relm
lines: Sketch and Lore — {2}{R}, {T}: Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant, sorcery, or creature card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature." Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Exiling from the top of the opponent's library until an instant, sorcery, or creature card is exiled, then casting that card free, has no until-hit form in the schema.

cards.name: Jenson Carthalion, Druid Exile
lines: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, scry 1. If that spell was all colors, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no multicolored spell selector (isMonocolored would also match colorless spells), so 'you cast a multicolored spell' cannot be filtered exactly, and the 'was all colors' check has no verified spell-object form.

cards.name: Quistis Trepe
lines: Blue Magic — When ~ enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the controller cast a targeted instant or sorcery card from a graveyard with any-type mana spent and an exile-instead-of-graveyard replacement on that spell.

cards.name: Vampire Nocturnus
lines: As long as the top card of your library is black, this creature and other Vampire creatures you control get +2/+1 and have flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition that reads the color of the top card of the controller's library, so the 'as long as the top card is black' gate cannot be stated.

cards.name: Vedalken Humiliator
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control three or more artifacts, creatures your opponents control lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes opposing creatures lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn: loseKeywordsEachUntilEot removes only named keywords, and no until-end-of-turn base-P/T setter exists.

cards.name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
lines: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, you may draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature attacks you, you may draw a card.
differences: Text A also triggers when a creature attacks a planeswalker you control; Text B only triggers on creatures attacking you.

cards.name: Four Knocks
lines: Vanishing 4
cards.backTranslation:
This enters with four time counters on it.
At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from this. If this has no time counters on it, sacrifice this.

cards.name: Summary Dismissal
lines: Exile all other spells and counter all abilities.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles all other spells on the stack or counters all abilities on the stack.

cards.name: Doom's Time Platform
lines: Whenever you attack, exile target nonland card from your graveyard with two time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Targeting a nonland card in your graveyard that has two time counters on it, and giving it suspend, has no schema form: graveyard cards carry no counters for a selector to read, and there is no grant-suspend effect.

cards.name: Teapot Slinger
lines: Whenever you expend 4, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for 'you expend 4', so the damage trigger cannot be attached to the expend event.

cards.name: Teneb, the Harvester
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, you may pay {2}{B}. If you do, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, target creature card in a graveyard. You may pay {2}{B}. If you do, put that card onto the battlefield.
differences: Text A puts the target creature card onto the battlefield under your control; Text B says only "put that card onto the battlefield", which under the default rule puts it under its owner's control.

cards.name: Yisan, the Wanderer Bard
lines: {2}{G}, {T}, Put a verse counter on ~: Search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to the number of verse counters on ~, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Putting a verse counter on the source as part of the activation cost has no cost form, and the search needs a mana value equal to the source's counter count, which the schema cannot express.

cards.name: Unexpected Fangs
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter and a lifelink counter on target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A lifelink counter gives the target creature lifelink for as long as it stays there, but the schema only grants counter-based keywords through staticEffects on a permanent, and an instant has no permanent to carry that static.

cards.name: Orzhov Enforcer
lines: Afterlife 1
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Unseal the Necropolis
lines: Each player mills three cards. Then you return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The untargeted 'return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand' has no schema op (graveyard-to-hand ops are single-target or return-all), and the only up-to-two form is a target slot, which the card does not use.

cards.name: Sinkhole Surveyor
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, you lose 1 life and this creature endures 1.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever this creature attacks, you lose 1 life. Then choose one —
• Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
• Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token.

cards.name: Turn to Frog
lines: Until end of turn, target creature loses all abilities and becomes a blue Frog with base power and toughness 1/1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCreatureUntilEot cannot also remove all of the target's abilities until end of turn; the schema has no until-end-of-turn loses-all-abilities effect.

cards.name: Stalactite Dagger
lines: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and is all creature types.
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and is every creature type.

cards.name: Stormchaser Drake
lines: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell you control, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The becomesTargeted trigger has no way to restrict the targeting source to a spell you control, so it would also fire for opposing spells and abilities that target it.

cards.name: Wartime Protestors
lines: Whenever another Ally you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature and it gains haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another Ally creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it and it gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Errant, Street Artist
lines: {1}{U}, {T}: Copy target spell you control that wasn't cast. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Copy target spell you control that wasn't cast' needs a filter on a spell that was not cast, and no selector or target kind expresses that; a copy of a cast spell would also be allowed.

cards.name: Quirion Beastcaller
lines: When this creature dies, distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that distributes a dies-trigger's last-known X +1/+1 counters among a variable number of chosen creatures (distributeCountersFromSource moves the source's counters, and putCountersEachChosen gives a fixed count to each).

cards.name: Squee's Revenge
lines: Choose a number. Flip a coin that many times or until you lose a flip, whichever comes first. If you win all the flips, draw two cards for each flip.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot have the controller choose a number, flip a coin that many times or until a loss, and draw two cards per flip based on the flips won.

cards.name: Dungeon Delver
lines: Commander creatures you own have "Room abilities of dungeons you own trigger an additional time."
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no rule static that makes Room abilities of dungeons you own trigger an additional time; triggerAdditionalTime covers only triggered abilities of permanents.

cards.name: Popular Entertainer
lines: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, goad target creature that player controls."
cards.backTranslation: Each creature you own that is a commander has "Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, goad target creature that player controls."

cards.name: Sire of Insanity
lines: At the beginning of each end step, each player discards their hand.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each player's end step, each player discards their hand, then draws 0 cards.

cards.name: Erratic Portal
lines: {1}, {T}: Return target creature to its owner's hand unless its controller pays {1}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'unless its controller pays {1}' payment belongs to the controller of the targeted creature, and no unlessPays payer names that player.

cards.name: Outnumber
lines: ~ deals damage to target creature equal to the number of creatures you control.
cards.backTranslation: This spell deals damage to target creature equal to the number of creatures you control.

cards.name: Curse of Exhaustion
lines: Enchanted player can't cast more than one spell each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: spellCastLimit applies to every player, and no static limits casts for only the enchanted player.

cards.name: Sylvan Advocate
lines: As long as you control six or more lands, this creature and land creatures you control get +2/+2.
cards.backTranslation: As long as you control six or more lands, this creature and each land creature you control get +2/+2.

cards.name: Aurora Awakener
lines: Vivid — When this creature enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X permanent cards, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control. Put any number of those permanent cards onto the battlefield, then put the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Revealing cards until a dynamic number of permanent cards equal to the colors among your permanents is found, then putting any number onto the battlefield, has no schema form.

cards.name: Harold and Bob, First Numens
lines: When ~ dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield. It's an Aura enchantment with enchant Forest you control and "Enchanted Forest has '{T}: Add three mana of any one color. You get two rad counters.'" ~ loses all other abilities.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot return a dying creature to the battlefield as an Aura attached to a Forest with a granted mana ability while removing its other abilities.

cards.name: Serra Redeemer
lines: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, put two +1/+1 counters on that creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, put two +1/+1 counters on that creature.

cards.name: Awakening
lines: At the beginning of each upkeep, untap all creatures and lands.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, untap each creature and each land on the battlefield.

cards.name: Biogenic Upgrade
lines: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on each of those creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op distributes three +1/+1 counters among one to three chosen targets; putCountersEachChosen places the same count on each chosen creature.

cards.name: Ironscale Hydra
lines: If a creature would deal combat damage to this creature, prevent that damage and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Preventing combat damage dealt to this creature while putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each such event is a replacement with a paired counter placement, and the schema has only a bare combat-damage prevention rule (preventCombatDamageToSelf) with no counter addition.

cards.name: Lupine Prototype
lines: ~ can't attack or block unless a player has no cards in hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The condition 'a player has no cards in hand' has no Condition kind, since the schema can only test the event player's hand size and the life total of players, not whether any player's hand is empty.

cards.name: Rampaging War Mammoth
lines: When you cycle this card, destroy up to X target artifacts.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for cycling a card, so 'when you cycle this card, destroy up to X target artifacts' cannot be attached to the cycling activation.

cards.name: Timeless Dragon
lines: Eternalize {2}{W}{W}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Eternalize's token copy cannot be made a black Zombie Dragon with no mana cost: createTokenCopyOf has no color or mana-cost override and no way to set the copy's subtype.

cards.name: Devout Chaplain
lines: {T}, Tap two untapped Humans you control: Exile target artifact or enchantment.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Tap two other Humans you control: Exile target artifact or enchantment.

cards.name: Mass Diminish
lines: Until your next turn, creatures target player controls have base power and toughness 1/1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema can set base power and toughness only for the duration of a static or until end of turn, and has no 'until your next turn' duration for setting creatures' base P/T on a target player's creatures.

cards.name: Aeronaut Admiral
lines: Vehicles you control have flying.
cards.backTranslation: Each permanent you control that has the Vehicle creature type has flying.

cards.name: Redirect
lines: You may choose new targets for target spell.
cards.backTranslation: Choose target spell. Choose new targets for that spell.
differences: Text A says 'You may choose new targets', so changing the targets is optional; Text B says 'Choose new targets for that spell' with no option to decline, so it is mandatory.

cards.name: Dunland Crebain
lines: When this creature enters, amass Orcs 2.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, amass Orc 2.

cards.name: Break Down
lines: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Create a Junk token.
cards.backTranslation: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Create a colorless Artifact — Junk token with no power or toughness. That token has "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card. Activate only as a sorcery."

cards.name: By Invitation Only
lines: Choose a number between 0 and 13. Each player sacrifices that many creatures of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no resolution-time chosen number that then sets how many creatures each player sacrifices; sacrificeEachPlayer takes only a fixed count.

cards.name: Dawn's Reflection
lines: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional two mana in any combination of colors.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever enchanted creature is tapped for mana, its controller adds two additional mana, each of any one color.
differences: Text A is triggered by an enchanted land being tapped for mana; Text B is triggered by an enchanted creature being tapped for mana.
Text A adds two mana in any combination of colors; Text B adds two mana all of one chosen color.

cards.name: Prismari Pianist
lines: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature token. If that spell's mana value is 5 or greater, create three of those tokens instead.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, if that spell's mana value is 5 or greater, create three 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature tokens. Otherwise, create one 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature token.

cards.name: Almost Perfect
lines: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 9/10 and has indestructible.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 9/10 and has indestructible.

cards.name: Rancid Rats
lines: Skulk
cards.inexpressibleReason: Skulk ('can't be blocked by creatures with greater power') is not a KeywordAbility in the schema, and no RuleStatic expresses a power-relative blocking restriction on the creature itself.

cards.name: Second Sunrise
lines: Each player returns to the battlefield all artifact, creature, enchantment, and land cards in their graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Returning only the cards put into the graveyard from the battlefield this turn, for each player, has no selector or op for that graveyard history.

cards.name: Urborg
lines: {T}: Target creature loses first strike or swampwalk until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The ability lets the controller choose whether the target creature loses first strike or swampwalk, and there is no targeted keyword-removal effect or swampwalk keyword to choose from (loseKeywordsEachUntilEot is untargeted and takes a selector).

cards.name: Kamiz, Obscura Oculus
lines: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. It connives. Then choose another attacking creature with lesser power. That creature gains double strike until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second target must be another attacker with lesser power than the first target, and the schema has no selector comparing against a target's power; connive is also an effect on the ability's source, not on the targeted creature.

cards.name: Feather, the Redeemed
lines: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature you control, exile that card instead of putting it into your graveyard as it resolves. If you do, return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way for a cast trigger to make the resolving instant or sorcery exile itself instead of going to the graveyard and then return it to hand at the next end step, because the only spell-exile effects act on the spell's own resolution (resolvingSpellExile), not on a cast-triggered replacement that delays a return.

cards.name: Ethereal Valkyrie
lines: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, draw a card, then exile a card from your hand face down. It becomes foretold. Its foretell cost is its mana cost reduced by {2}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles a chosen card from your hand face down and makes it foretold with a reduced foretell cost; grantForetell only applies to the hand as a static.

cards.name: General Marhault Elsdragon
lines: Whenever a creature you control becomes blocked, it gets +3/+3 until end of turn for each creature blocking it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The +3/+3 per creature blocking that specific attacker needs a count of blockers of the triggering creature, and no Value counts the creatures blocking a given object (combatRole blocking counts all blockers).

cards.name: Glasses of Urza
lines: {T}: Look at target player's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets a player look at a target player's hand; revealHandAndDiscard reveals and discards, and nothing expresses a private look.

cards.name: Shao Jun
lines: Leap Strike — During your turn, ~ has flying and first strike.
validatorIssues: unrecognized rules text: "Rope Dart — Tap two untapped artifacts you control: ~ deals 1 damage to each opponent."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only line left to implement (Leap Strike) is expressible, but the validator rejects the already-parsed Rope Dart line as unrecognized, which no patch can fix without duplicating that ability.

cards.name: Erinis, Gloom Stalker
lines: Choose a Background
validatorIssues: override for "Erinis, Gloom Stalker" has no executable behavior
cards.inexpressibleReason: Choose a Background is a deck-construction rule with no in-game behavior, and the IR has no way to record a rules line that does nothing, so the validator rejects an override without executable behavior.

cards.name: Ori, Plate Stacker
lines: When ~ enters, destroy all artifacts and enchantments your opponents control. You gain 1 life for each permanent destroyed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The life gain must equal the number of permanents this destroy actually destroys (indestructible ones excluded), and no value reads the count of permanents destroyed by an earlier effect in the same resolution.

cards.name: Sutina, Speaker of the Tajuru
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, you may return a land you control to its owner's hand. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'you may return a land you control; when you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature' reflexive trigger has no op that returns a land as the reflexive cost.

cards.name: Ashroot Animist
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, target other creature you control gains trample until end of turn and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.

cards.name: Vampire Hexmage

cards.name: Storm Fleet Negotiator
lines: Parley — Whenever this creature attacks, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you create a Map token. Then each player draws a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect that reveals each player's top card and creates a Map token per nonland card revealed, so the Parley reveal-and-count cannot be stated.

cards.name: Taunting Kobold
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, goad target creature an opponent controls.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this attacks, goad target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Chalice of the Void
lines: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on this artifact, counter that spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The counter op only acts on an announced target slot, and there is no way to counter the triggering spell itself (the cast spell that fired the castsSpell trigger) without a chosen target.

cards.name: Wildborn Preserver
lines: Whenever another non-Human creature you control enters, you may pay {X}. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The reflexive 'you may pay {X}. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters' needs a variable announced payment X feeding the counter count, and the schema's optional payment ops take only a fixed ParsedManaCost.

cards.name: Haliya, Ascendant Cadet
lines: Whenever one or more creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever one or more creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them deal combat damage to a player, you draw a card. This trigger is aggregated by the player dealt the combat damage.

cards.name: Prognostic Sphinx
lines: Discard a card: ~ gains hexproof until end of turn. Tap it.
cards.backTranslation: Discard a card: This creature gains hexproof until end of turn. Tap this creature.

cards.name: Agate-Blade Assassin
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, the defending player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Dead Man's Chest
lines: When enchanted creature dies, exile cards equal to its power from the top of its owner's library. You may cast spells from among those cards for as long as they remain exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no dies trigger on the creature this Aura enchants, and no way to exile cards from the owner's library with a cast permission that lasts for as long as they remain exiled.

cards.name: Rotwidow Pack
lines: {3}{B}{G}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a 1/2 green Spider creature token with reach, then each opponent loses 1 life for each Spider you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost 'exile a creature card from your graveyard' has no cost component that filters graveyard cards by creature type (exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard takes no selector and exileCardFromHand is hand-only).

cards.name: Coalition Victory
lines: You win the game if you control a land of each basic land type and a creature of each color.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition checks for controlling a land of each basic land type and a creature of each color, and no effect makes the controller win the game.

cards.name: Suppressor Skyguard
lines: Whenever a player attacks you, if that player has another opponent who isn't being attacked, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this combat.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if 'that player has another opponent who isn't being attacked' has no Condition kind, since the schema can test attack groups and opponent counts but not whether a different opponent is left unattacked.

cards.name: Puca's Mischief
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exchange control of target nonland permanent you control and target nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exchanges control of two chosen permanents with a mana value comparison; gainControl and swapCreatureControlUntilEot do not cover a nonland permanent exchange with equal or lesser mana value.

cards.name: Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer
lines: Creatures you control get +3/+0 as long as you control three or more artifacts.
cards.backTranslation: As long as you control three or more artifacts, each creature you control gets +3/+0.

cards.name: Scorn-Blade Berserker
lines: Backup 1
cards.inexpressibleReason: Backup grants another creature the card's own sacrifice-and-draw activated ability with its costs, and grantAbilityUntilEot carries no activation costs.

cards.name: Slickshot Show-Off
lines: Plot {1}{R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Plot (exile from hand for {1}{R}, then cast free as a sorcery on a later turn) is not an alternative cast kind in the schema.

cards.name: Another Chance
lines: You may mill two cards. Then return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional mill of two cards must happen before the graveyard creature cards are chosen, and the schema has no 'return up to two chosen creature cards from your graveyard to hand' effect that works on chosen graveyard slots, so the up-to-two choice cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Scion of Halaster
lines: Commander creatures you own have "The first time you would draw a card each turn, instead look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your graveyard and the other back on top of your library. Then draw a card."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting commander creatures a replacement effect on their first draw each turn (look at top two, graveyard one, then draw) has no schema static that grants a replacement or draw-replacement ability.

cards.name: Mr. Foxglove
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, draw cards equal to the number of cards in defending player's hand minus the number of cards in your hand. If you didn't draw cards this way, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The draw count 'cards in defending player's hand minus cards in your hand' has no Value reading the attacked defending player's hand size, and the 'if you didn't draw cards this way' follow-on needs that same count.

cards.name: Increasing Ambition
lines: Search your library for a card and put that card into your hand. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, instead search your library for two cards and put those cards into your hand. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition for 'if this spell was cast from a graveyard', so the search count cannot switch between one card and two based on where it was cast.

cards.name: Vow of Torment
lines: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2, has menace, and can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
cards.backTranslation:
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has menace.
Enchanted creature can't attack. This restriction includes planeswalkers.
differences: Text A stops the enchanted creature only from attacking you or planeswalkers you control; Text B says it can't attack at all, which also forbids attacking other players.

cards.name: Scholar of the Lost Trove
lines: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant, sorcery, or artifact card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If an instant or sorcery spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that casts a targeted instant, sorcery or artifact card from the controller's graveyard without paying its mana cost, nor the exile-instead replacement for such a spell.

cards.name: Phyrexian Dreadnought
lines: When this creature enters, sacrifice it unless you sacrifice any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no unless-sacrifice payment that requires sacrificing any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, so the sacrifice-unless clause cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Guidelight Pathmaker
lines: When this Vehicle enters, you may search your library for an artifact card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield if its mana value is 2 or less. Otherwise, put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The found artifact's destination depends on its mana value (battlefield if 2 or less, otherwise hand), but searchLibrary fixes its destinations per card before the card is revealed, so no single search can route by mana value.

cards.name: Pox Plague
lines: Each player loses half their life, then discards half the cards in their hand, then sacrifices half the permanents they control of their choice. Round down each time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value is half of life, hand, or permanents rounded down, and loseLife, discard, and sacrifice take only fixed amounts.

cards.name: Return the Past
lines: During your turn, each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard has flashback. Its flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema can grant flashback only to the card itself (castFromGraveyard), not to every instant and sorcery card in the controller's graveyard during their turn.

cards.name: Ghired's Belligerence
lines: ~ deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures. Whenever a creature dealt damage this way dies this turn, populate.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The populate trigger for each creature dealt damage this way that dies this turn needs a delayed trigger bound to that damaged set, which the schema cannot express.

cards.name: Otterball Antics
lines: Create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess. If this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Prowess is not a KeywordAbility in the schema, so the created Otter token cannot carry it.

cards.name: Lightstall Inquisitor
lines: When this creature enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand and may play that card for as long as it remains exiled. Each spell cast this way costs {1} more to cast. Each land played this way enters tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes each opponent exile a card from their hand that they may play for as long as it remains exiled, with a {1} cost increase on spells cast that way and an enters-tapped rule for lands played that way.

cards.name: Acolyte of Bahamut
lines: Commander creatures you own have "The first Dragon spell you cast each turn costs {2} less to cast."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting commander creatures a cost reduction for the first Dragon spell each turn is not expressible, because cost reductions are rule statics and cannot be granted through an added ability.

cards.name: Blight Pile
lines: {2}{B}, {T}: Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creatures with defender you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Counting the creatures with defender you control needs a hasKeyword selector, which the schema marks event-only, so it cannot count them in a resolving activated ability.

cards.name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
lines: Creatures with no abilities get +2/+2.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no selector for creatures with no abilities, so 'creatures with no abilities get +2/+2' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Shenanigans
lines: Dredge 1
cards.inexpressibleReason: Dredge 1 (replace a draw by milling and returning the card from graveyard to hand) has no keyword or replacement effect in the schema.
